title: Verbs of Legal Remedy and Statutory Compliance

sections.title: Contestation with Postpositions ellen and szemben
sections.content: Challenging an official resolution, act, or verdict requires postpositional structures: fellebbez a határozat ellen (to appeal against a resolution), kifogást emel valami ellen (to lodge an objection against something), and pert indít a hatósággal szemben (to launch a lawsuit against the authority).

sections.title: Compliance and Approval with the Dative (-nak/-nek)
sections.content: Accepting, upholding, or complying with administrative acts governs the dative: eleget tesz a felszólításnak (to comply with a summons/deadline), helyt ad a keresetnek (the court upholds/grants the lawsuit), and ellentmond a jogszabálynak (contradicts the legal statute).

sections.title: Contestation vs. Compliance Verbs
rows: Az ügyfél fellebbezett az elsőfokú elutasítás ellen.
The client appealed against the first-instance rejection.
A bíróság helyt adott a polgár keresetének.
The court upheld the citizen's lawsuit.
A hivatal köteles eleget tenni a bírósági ítéletnek.
The office is obliged to comply with the court ruling.

items.spanish: A vállalkozás jogorvoslatért folyamodott a bírságot kiszabó határozat ellen.
items.english: The enterprise sought legal remedy against the resolution imposing the fine.

items.spanish: A közigazgatási bíróság helyt adott a fellebbező kérésének és megsemmisítette a döntést.
items.english: The administrative court upheld the appellant's request and nullified the decision.

items.spanish: Az alperes mindenben eleget tett a határidőben előírt kötelezettségeinek.
items.english: The defendant complied in all respects with the obligations prescribed within the deadline.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Distinguish: 'helyt ad valaminek' (court upholds a claim, dative) from 'elutasít valamit' (court rejects a claim, accusative).
